passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

primaryAbilities.name: Glitterlance
primaryAbilities.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Enemies take {{ bonusmissiledamage }} magic damage from additional bolts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Whimsy
primaryAbilities.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants {{ totalms }} Move Speed and {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ msduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Help, Pix!
primaryAbilities.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for {{ pixonallyduration }} seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight of them for {{ pixonenemyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Wild Growth
primaryAbilities.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Lulu enlarges an ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> surrounding enemies for {{ knockbackduration }} second. The enlarged ally gains <healing>{{ totalbonushealth }} max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
